en: Oh! Shuichi and Tsumugi!

Gonta, did you see Keebo around
here anywhere?
N-No, Gonta not see him.

Huh? You didn't? But I heard his voice
close by...

Then, did something fall off the roof!?
You heard that loud noise, right!?

O-Oh... Gonta hear noise, but Gonta not
see anything.
Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>What could that mean...?

<CLT=cltMIND>I thought I heard the sound and
Keebo's voice close by...
<CLT=cltMIND>But Gonta didn't see anything?

<CLT=cltMIND>And what about Kaito?
He should have heard that from the roof...

<CLT=cltMIND>He would have run over here
right away... What's going on?
Hey, Shuichi... What does this all mean?
<CLT=cltMIND>Such strange occurrences...
<CLT=cltMIND>...Alright. My talent...is solving mysteries.
<CLT=cltMIND>So that's what I'm going to do.
We need to figure out why Keebo screamed.

Let's head to the chapel!
Something might have happened there.
Y-Yeah...you're right.

What happen? Did something happen to
Keebo?
Let's go to the chapel!

Keebo should be there.
Something might have happened!
Y-Yeah!

Shuichi, perfect timing! Is there anything
over there that can serve as a bridge!?

Huh...? Keebo's over there? Then what 
was that shouting I heard earlier?

Hey, we should hurry and find something
else to replace the bridge with.
Y-Yeah! We might be able to make it in time!
Make it in time? What do you mean—

What happened? Why are you guys making
such a scene?
Kokichi!

I didn't see anyone in the dining room, so I
went to look for you guys...

Ah-haha, looks like everyone's in trouble
now that Miu dropped the bridge.

Th-This is no time for laughter! We need
to find a replacement bridge—
Ooh, but the bridge is over here, y'know?
What?
C'mon, over here.
...Anyway, let's go.
Kokichi told us, so now I'm worried...
Let's just wait and see what happens.

See, the signboard stuck on that boulder
is the same one Miu dropped, right?
You're right! It got swept all the way here!

Leave it to Gonta!
Gonta just need to carry signboard!?

Now that that's dealt with, let's head back
to where everyone else is.
Hrm...are they back yet?
Oh, they're here.
So Gonta just need to put board over river?

But board is so thin. Will it be okay?
What if board breaks this ti—

It may be thin, but it's made of sturdy wood!
So, can you hurry up and put the bridge down!?
O-Okay! Got it!
What's wrong? What happened over there!?

I'll explain later. But, we need to log out
right now.
Log out?
Huh? Where's Miu?
S-Something happened to her!
What do you mean!?
We're not sure, but her avatar isn't moving.

Maybe something happened in the real world
that's preventing her from moving it.

Th-This looks real bad, guys... Okay...let's
head to the salon and log out, ASAP.
...Hey, where's Kaito?

Ah, Kaito! I-I don't know, I ran here
as fast as I could, I didn't check the roof...

...You didn't even bother going to the roof
to get him. You're colder than I thought.
...Huh?
Shuichi, let's hurry!
I have to log out, they're waiting for me!
Toilet paper...?

Never mind that now, I need to
head to the chapel!
I have to log out, they're waiting for me!
<CLT=cltMIND>I have to hurry to the chapel!

<CLT=cltMIND>Something might have happened to Keebo!
No time for detours, I have to go to the chapel!
